Hi Marta / AP team,

Hope you’re well — checking in on invoice 4312 (total $28,540, PO #98765). We haven’t received remittance confirmation yet and our records show the invoice is due next Tuesday (Aug 24). Can you confirm which payment method AP will use (ACH, wire, or virtual card) and the expected settlement date?

If helpful, we can provide wire instructions or push a virtual-card payment link; ACH is preferred on your side, we can accommodate. Also, if AP needs a vendor W-9 or alternate remit name, let me know and I’ll attach it.

Next steps we’re hoping for:
- Confirm payment method and ETA by EOD tomorrow (Thu, Aug 20)
- If wire: confirm bank name & ref required (we’ll include INV-4312)
- If virtual card: confirm amount/limit and we’ll send the link

I’ve cc’d Ben for collection backlog context and Kimberly for PO validation.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirm so we can mark the invoice pending on our side.

Best,

Olga — thanks for the nudge.

Short answers:
- AP has PO #98765 on file and the invoice looks OK.
- Our standard is ACH, but we need a completed W-9 and explicit remit instructions that match our vendor record (legal name + tax ID). Once we have that, payments are typically scheduled on our next run (Mon, Aug 24).
- If there’s urgency and you can accept a wire, I can escalate to finance, but our AP team prefers ACH for reconciliation.

Can you send back:
1) PDF of the invoice (vendor header + legal entity)
2) W-9 (or equivalent tax form)
3) Remit instructions (bank details OR pay portal link)

If you want me to try wire escalation, I’ll need your bank name, account holder, last four, and estimated USD amount.

Thanks — I’ll hold the PO open until end of day Friday pending receipt.

-Marta
